definitions.explanation: Medication taken to induce or maintain sleep. In Japan most types require a prescription.

examples.japanese: {睡眠薬|すいみんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧{睡眠薬|すいみんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the doctor prescribe a mild sleeping pill.

examples.japanese: {睡眠薬|すいみんやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{依存|いぞん}して→依存する：20026_izonsuru⟧しまう{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Relying too heavily on sleeping pills can lead to dependence.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧ (sleep) + {薬|やく} (medicine). The everyday term for prescription or over-the-counter sleep aids.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {睡眠薬|すいみんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take a sleeping pill
- {睡眠薬|すいみんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prescribe sleeping pills
- {睡眠薬|すいみんやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧: to rely on sleeping pills
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧/⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧{睡眠薬|すいみんやく}: strong/mild sleeping pills

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {睡眠導入剤|すいみんどうにゅうざい}: sleep-inducing drug — more clinical term, technically distinguished but often used interchangeably
- {安定剤|あんていざい}: tranquilizer — for anxiety rather than sleep, but sometimes confused
